FAQs: Subheading
entries.default: Read Through Some of Our Frequently Asked Questions

default.a: PFX is a white-label pizza vending platform — automated kiosks that let operators, regional chains, and franchisors sell their own recipes under their own brand, 24/7, without the overhead of a traditional storefront.
Fresh pizzas are prepped and loaded into the kiosk, which stores, bakes, and dispenses each order on demand through a self-serve touchscreen and payment terminal — typically ready in under 5 minutes.

default.q: How Does PFX Ensure Pizza Quality?
default.a: Because you supply your own dough, sauce, cheese, and toppings, every pizza reflects your own recipes and standards. Each kiosk is also temperature- and freshness-monitored to keep ingredients within safe, high-quality ranges.

default.q: How Are The Kiosks Cleaned And Maintained?
default.a: Operators handle routine daily cleaning and restocking, while PFX backs every kiosk with a 1-year parts & labor warranty, remote monitoring, and a 24/7 technical support helpline.

default.q: Is The Inside Of The Machine Clean?
default.a: Pizzas never come into contact with the inside of the machine during loading, baking, or serving—they’re baked directly in the box they arrive in. Our units are NAMA approved for sanitary food vending, and both the interior and exterior of every PizzaForno machine are cleaned regularly.

default.q: How Does The Machine Keep Pizzas Fresh?
default.a: Once a pizza is inserted into the machine, an automated system tracks the ‘best before’ dates of all pizzas to ensure food quality and safety. Using a first-in, first-out approach, it prioritizes freshness and automatically removes any pizzas past their shelf life from the available inventory, ensuring customers receive only fresh products.

default.q: What is the ROI On These Kiosks?
default.a: Returns vary by location, foot traffic, and pricing — use our [ROI Calculator](/roicalculator) to model projected earnings, payback period, and lifetime ROI for your specific setup.

default.q: How Long Does It Take To Fulfil An Order?
default.a: As each kiosk is custom-built to order, the minimum lead time for fulfilment is approximately 3 weeks. This allows us the time needed to manufacture and prepare your kiosk before delivery.

PFX is the white-label automation platform and hardware, powered by PizzaForno's technology. PizzaForno is the original consumer-facing brand; PFX lets you run the same technology entirely under your own brand.
